items.label: 〜ってありますか？
items.note: Casual って stands in for が/は (自転車ってありますか).

items.label: 〜てみたいなと思って。
items.note: No catalog match. Suggested: 〜てみたい(な)と思って — "I was thinking I'd like to try ~" (〜てみる + たい + と思う). n5-tai covers only たい.

items.label: 〜てもらって、申し訳ないので
items.note: No catalog match. Suggested: 〜てもらう — "have someone do ~ for me" (with 申し訳ない, "sorry for having you ~"). n5-node covers only ので.

items.label: 〜なくていいのに。
items.note: 〜なくていい is the short form of なくてもいい; trailing のに ("even though") has no catalog entry.

items.label: 〜あったはずよ。
items.note: No catalog match. Suggested: 〜はず — "should be; is supposed to be (expectation)".

items.label: 〜おかしくないですか？
items.note: Negative i-adjective おかしくない used as a "isn't it ~?" question.

items.label: どれがいい？
items.note: No catalog match. Suggested: どれがいい？ — "which one is good/do you want?" (どれ = which, of 3+).

items.label: 〜と思いますか？
items.note: No catalog match. Suggested: 〜と思いますか — "do you think ~?" (〜と思う).

items.label: 〜のほうが
items.note: Also on spoken lines 3, 6, 10. Comparative 〜の方が used without より.

items.label: 〜そうね
items.note: No catalog match. Suggested: 〜そう — "looks/seems ~" (appearance; 軽そうね).

items.label: 〜てみます
items.note: No catalog match. Suggested: 〜てみる — "try doing ~".

items.label: 〜ていいのよ
items.note: Short form 〜ていい (permission) + のよ.

items.label: 〜わね
items.note: No catalog match. Suggested: 〜わ(ね) — feminine sentence-ending わ (soft emphasis), here with ね.

items.label: 〜払います
items.note: No catalog match. Label is a plain polite verb (払います); suggested: 〜ます — polite non-past verb form.

items.label: 〜にさせて
items.note: No catalog match. Suggested: 〜にさせて — "let me make it ~" (causative of にする; cf. n5-ni-suru).

items.label: 〜ように
items.note: No catalog match. Suggested: 〜ように — "so that ~ (purpose/goal)".

items.label: 〜てみて
items.note: No catalog match. Suggested: 〜てみる — "try doing ~". Also on spoken line 1.

items.label: 〜でいいから
items.note: No catalog match. Suggested: 〜でいい — "~ is fine/enough" (ゆっくりでいいから).

items.label: 〜てきました
items.note: No catalog match. Suggested: 〜てくる (〜てきた) — "change that has come about / started to ~".

items.label: 〜できます
items.note: No catalog match, and できます is not literally in any line; line 8 has the potential form 行けます. Suggested: potential form (〜える/〜られる) — "can ~".

items.label: 〜てね
items.note: Casual て-form request + ね (気をつけてね), ください dropped.
